universal_lens: A Bayesian hierarchical model integrating Elo-based skill, experience, and contextual features to predict elite badminton outcomes, with XGBoost feature importance quantifying determinants. primitives.name: Hot Hand Fallacy Quantifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: 19 4.2.1 Quantifying the "Hot Hand" Fallacy in Racket Sports 336 The relatively low importance of the recent win percentage (15.5%) cumulatively for both players, 337 compared to long term skill and experience provides strong evidence for a "hot hand" fallacy.
